headline: ONS reports UK Q3 growth while leaving AI/cloud contribution unquantified
summary: The UK Office for National Statistics’ first estimate puts real GDP growth at 0.7% in 2026 Q3. Information and communication output rose 2.1%, with computer programming and consultancy up 4.4%. ONS says the sector has been the largest driver of GDP growth across 2026 and that many businesses reporting the largest turnover increases are involved in AI- or cloud-related activity. The release says the exact turnover impact is difficult to quantify; it does not measure an AI-specific contribution or establish that AI caused the sector’s growth. The GDP estimate is preliminary and subject to revision.
